lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct vertical white lines traversing the lateral torso; spacing is approximately uniform across the center with slight narrowing toward the dorsal ridge.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A single bifurcation is visible at the dorsal-most point of the 8th and 9th lines (counting anterior to posterior) where they converge.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The 1st anterior line terminates mid-lateral; the 11th posterior line is a shortened segment that terminates above the mid-lateral point.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Low-density cluster of three high-contrast white spots located on the lateral haunch area.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white horizontal patch on the carpal joint of the front leg and white markings on the lower throat and muzzle.
